summary.text: SANDNES ELEKTRISKE AS is a private limited company registered in Sandnes, founded 1977-06-15. Its website describes the business as follows: "Enkelt, rimelig - alt elektrisk på samme sted" Its main industry code is 43.210 (elektrisk installasjonsarbeid). The register shows 10 employees and 3 registered workplaces. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 10 021 242 NOK and the annual result was -78 041 NOK; operating income was up from 8 524 493 NOK in 2024. Registered leadership: Morten Aarrestad (daglig leder) and Jan Marton Aarrestad (styrets leder), with 2 other board members. Its verified website is sandneselektriske.no, which links to its Facebook profile. Recent changes in the register: employees set to 10 on 2026-10-13; share capital set to 9500.0 on 2026-05-13; latest filed accounts year set to 2025 on 2026-02-19.
